history.value: A twin read (two nets whose training differs in one config key, read on the mutated bench) needs three training seeds before it says anything: the per-seed twin difference has a training-seed sd of about 0.03 win rate (rate columns against their twins on sharp2: +0.033, -0.028, -0.016), about 2.5x a seed's own se at 200 starts x 8, so one pair mostly reads that seed's luck on unfamiliar hook powers; pool the per-start means over seeds and read the pooled se (about 0.008-0.009 at three seeds).
